notes.purpose: Give one no-ID pig its tag and sex; each Confirm saves that pig.
rules: Tag and Sex are required; Notch and Parents are optional.
Each confirm migrates the pig's batch from the pen's partition to the animal record: one head leaves the pen batch row.
issues: Drawn in the place workflow deck (ux/system/workflows/place.html); no Astra prototype screen opens it.

screens.name: Assign identity · tag keypad
screens.zh: 分配身份 · 耳标键盘

notes.purpose: The tag is pre-filled from the last one plus 1 and the keypad opens to correct it.
rules: Sex is not carried forward: a litter is mixed.
The list under the tag box is the receipt of pigs already saved.
issues: Drawn in the place workflow deck (ux/system/workflows/place.html); no Astra prototype screen opens it.

notes.purpose: A notch entered pre-fills Sex, and a known litter opens Parents as read-only cards.
rules: The pre-filled sex is editable and names its source (from her notch).
Parents come from her litter record; an empty Parents field is the only warning.
edge: Whether the notch-to-sex table is farm config or breed convention is open.
issues: Drawn in the place workflow deck (ux/system/workflows/place.html); no Astra prototype screen opens it.

notes.purpose: Marking 3 pigs as breeding stock when 1 has no tag runs identity for that pig first, then the mark sheet opens with all 3.
rules: The verb never greys out or detours: it splices identity in.
Backing out abandons only this pig's fields; saved identities stand and the mark was never written.
Only verbs that pin to an individual gate on identity (cycle events and the breeding mark).
